590833789.text: You can now import semantically-rich entities from SAP S/4HANA On-Premise v1610 or higher connections via the Import Entities wizard.See [Importing Entities with Semantics from SAP S/4HANA](845fedbd28574aa8b84239df848936f6.html).
590833789.title: Import Semantically-Rich Entities from SAP S/4HANA On-Premise Connections

590833790.text: The new Define Partitions wizard, available in the View Persistency Monitor, can analyze your view and suggest suitable columns on which to partition your data.See [Creating Partitions for Your Persisted Views](9b1b595054c34da5b67ac07595093f82.html).
590833790.title: New Define Partitions Wizard Can Suggest Suitable Partitioning Columns

590833791.text:
Using options available for creating, editing, and removing task scheduling, you can now suspend or pause scheduled data integration tasks such as remote table replication, persisting views, data flow and task chain execution.
After pausing a scheduled task, future scheduled runs will also not be executed, however, the defined schedule for those runs is still saved. So, when you resume a paused task, execution of future scheduled task runs will also resume.
See [Pause or Resume a Scheduled Task](5eb55cbcaa8241f5a488d16036e78e15.html).
590833791.title: Pausing Scheduled Tasks in the Edit Schedule dialog

590833792.text:
The View Analyzer has been enhanced with some improvements:
- A smoother navigation within the results thanks to a new user interface, and a graphical dependency graph, that allows you to understand the data provenance,
- The possibility to start a view persistency simulation for one or several views of your data model, with the ability to check how much memory would be consuming and the number of records to be persisted.
See [Exploring Views with View Analyzer](8921e5acf2ad4c8a98073edae4c214c7.html).
590833792.title: Execute View Analyzer with Memory Consumption Checks

590833793.text:
In the Remote Table Monitors, two new columns have been added to help you to quickly identify issues with your data replication in real-time:
- Latest Change (Source) will help you to identify performance issues with your data replication from the source system to SAP Data Warehouse Cloud to ensure that your data is always up-to-date.
- Number of Records will help you to identify transport errors with your data replication to ensure that your data is fully copied into SAP Data Warehouse Cloud.
See: [Monitoring Remote Tables](4dd95d7bff1f48b399c8b55dbdd34b9e.html).
590833793.title: Ensure That Your Data Replicated in Real-time are Accurate and Complete

590833794.text:
While creating or updating an SAP HANA connection, you can now choose between two options:
- Remote Only: It prevents users to replicate remote tables.
- Remote and Replication: It allows users to replicate remote tables whenever they need to do it.
See:
- [Remote Tables in Data Access Remote Only Vs Data Access Remote and Replication](9b9db1490df6452a843f5081581aa5a3.html)
- [SAP HANA Connections](e6b63f176d3640609adcf06297fb37e9.html#loioe6b63f176d3640609adcf06297fb37e9)
590833794.title: Prevent Users From Replicating Remote Tables

590833795.text:
You can now deploy multiple task chains at the same time, in addition to other objects, using the “Deploy after Import” Transport application option.
See [Importing Content from Another Tenant](b607a12931d74c4a93506ea64c55ab4e.html).
590833795.title: Mass Deployment of Task Chains in the Transport Application

590833796.text:
In the View Persistency Monitor, you can now refresh a single or multiple partitions for a dedicated view, even if the partitions are locked. You can thus avoid running a full data load.
See [Creating Partitions for Your Persisted Views](9b1b595054c34da5b67ac07595093f82.html).
590833796.title: Manual Refresh of Single or Multiple Partitions

590833797.text:
With the connection type, you can now access all SAP SuccessFactors services including OData V4 API endpoints. The restriction to being able to access selected entities for Analytical Dashboards only has been removed.
See [SAP SuccessFactors Connections](39df02030d4b411487bacecf9afea4e8.html).
590833797.title: Fully Enabled SAP SuccessFactors Connection

590833798.text:
The import wizards for importing entities from SAP S/4HANA Cloud into SAP Datasphere and for importing entities from SAP BW bridge have been merged. The import process now works the same for both types of import.
See [Importing Entities with Semantics from SAP S/4HANA](845fedbd28574aa8b84239df848936f6.html) and [Importing Entities with Semantics from SAP BW∕4HANA or SAP BW Bridge](7bcd3218b4064b898ca367b47ff246e2.html).
590833798.title: Improved Import Wizard for Entities

590833799.text:
The ODATA APIs have been renamed toSAP Datasphere Consumption APIs.
On the SAP API Business Hub, the APIs have been split into two packages: one for Catalog and one for Consumption.
See [SAP API Business Hub](https://api.sap.com/package/sapdatawarehousecloud/overview).
590833799.title: SAP Datasphere Consumption APIs

590833800.text:
You can now use X.509 client certificates or certificate chains for authentication when creating connections to Cloud Data Integration endpoints and to SAP S/4HANA Cloud in a more secure way including encryption. For new connections, X.509 Client Certificate becomes the default authentication type.
See:
- [Cloud Data Integration Connections](cd33107246f446628f9baff56faf5a1b.html)
- [SAP S/4HANA Cloud Connections](a98e5ffdf47c44d9a845dca01a18bd82.html)
590833800.title: X.509 Client Certificate Support for Cloud Data Integration and SAP S/4HANA Cloud Connections

590833801.text:
The remote tables statistics creation has been moved from the Remote Table Monitor to the Remote Query Monitor.
See [Creating Statistics for Your Remote Tables](e4120bbb98e44994aa1e0b32ff3f209d.html).
590833801.title: Remote Table Statistics Move to the Remote Query Monitor

590833802.text:
In addition to monitor user interface enhancements provided in previous releases, the monitor tab displays for remote table replication, view persistency, data flow, and task chain runs now provide additional substatus log message detail for failed task runs.
See [Navigating in the Monitor Tabs](5d4af7620a214872a4dc5286f5e9e997.html).
590833802.title: Additional substatus log message information provided for failed task runs

590833803.text:
You can use the OData APIs to search and replicate data following the OData version 4 standard. With these APIs, you can extend existing integration capabilities with SAP Analytics Cloud, and you are given the freedom to build your own solutions.
See [Consuming Data via the OData API](7a453609c8694b029493e7d87e0de60a.html).
590833803.title: Browse Data via the SAP Datasphere Public APIs

590833804.text:
A number of usability enhancements are available in the list of connections:
- You can now use  (Select Columns) to select the columns that you want to display and to decide on the order in which they are displayed in the list.
- You can additionally display the Technical Name via the column selection, and you can sort the connections list on the new column. Along with adding the Technical Name column, the Name column has been renamed to Business Name.
- Search now considers Technical Name, Real-Time Replication Status, and Owner in addition to the Business Name.
590833804.title: Improved Usability in Connections List

590833805.text:
From the View Persistency Monitor details screen, use the new View Analyzer to analyze the entities that compose your data model. You can then use this information to decide on some improvements.
See [Exploring Views with View Analyzer](8921e5acf2ad4c8a98073edae4c214c7.html).
590833805.title: Explore Your Views with View Analyzer

590833806.text:
You can now leverage load balancing by connecting to an RFC message server rather than directly connecting to specific application servers. Load Balancing is supported for SAP ABAP, SAP BW, SAP ECC, and SAP S/4HANA (on-premise) connection types.
See [SAP ABAP Connections](a75c1aacf951449ba3b740c7e46da3a9.html), [SAP BW Connections](e589041e80264f43b6c209c407336376.html), [SAP ECC Connections](e546ccd61af54bf49a0f531a43fe0961.html), and [SAP S/4HANA On-Premise Connections](a49a1e3cc50f4af89711d8306bdd8f26.html).
590833806.title: Load Balancing for ABAP-based Connections

590833807.text:
Remote tables connected via SAP HANA smart data access must have only one remote table per remote source object in data access Replicated. If several remote tables point to the same source object, they must use the same replicated data.
See [Monitoring Remote Tables](4dd95d7bff1f48b399c8b55dbdd34b9e.html).
590833807.title: One Replication per Source Object for Remote Tables Connected via SAP HANA Smart Data Access

590833808.text:
Monitoring of task chain execution has been added to the Data Integration Monitor. You can view the status and progress of task chains that are scheduled to run, are currently running, or have already been run. In addition, you can view more detailed information on task chain runs, including sub-task execution log messages .
See [Monitoring Task Chains](4142201ec1aa49faad89a688a2f1852c.html).
590833808.title: Task Chain Monitoring

590833809.text: In the Data Integration Monitor, task logs have been enhanced: A download link will appear against a message only in case it contains more information that can’t be displayed in the monitor. You can then download the log to perform deeper analysis on what has happened with your task.
590833809.title: Download of task logs

590833810.text:
When you create a connection, the space name is no longer hardcoded as a prefix in the connection technical name. This change lets you export data flows from one space to a JSON file and then import the file into another space that contains a connection with the same name.
See [Importing Objects from a CSN/JSON File](23599e6347fb4c9e9a71c82f62449875.html).
590833810.title: Import/Export of Data Flow JSON from One Space to Another

590833811.text:
When you create a simple schedule to run daily tasks, the tasks are run at a fixed frequency that is by default now not reset on the first day of each month. You can however ask that the run cycle is reset every month, using the new option Reset Every Month.
For example, if you schedule a daily task to run every two days and the last run of the month is January 31, the next run will be:
- on February 1 if you select the option Reset Every Month, as the run cycle is reset on the first of each month
- on February 2 if you do not select the option Reset Every Month
Note
The new option is selected by default for the schedules that you've created before version 2022.9.
See [Schedule a Data Integration Task (Simple Schedule)](7c11059ed3314e1fb753736b7867512c.html).
590833811.title: Schedule Daily Data Integration Tasks Without Reset on the First of Each Month

590833812.text:
When you think the data will no longer change, or no change is expected for a while, you can check the option Locked when you define a partition, and avoid unnecessary data load while persisting a view.
See [Creating Partitions for Your Persisted Views](9b1b595054c34da5b67ac07595093f82.html).
590833812.title: Lock Your Partitions to Avoid Unnecessary Data Load

590833813.text:
You can now use authentication type OAuth 2.0 with Generic OData and SAP SuccessFactors for Analytical Dashboard connections to increase security when authorizing SAP Datasphere to connect to OData services. Generic OData supports the OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow whereas SAP SuccessFactors for Analytical Dashboards supports the SAML bearer assertion flow. For new connections, OAuth 2.0 becomes the default authentication type.
See:
- [Generic OData Connections](5d36f1aae68a4e59989c424a66d948c9.html)
- [SAP SuccessFactors Connections](39df02030d4b411487bacecf9afea4e8.html)
590833813.title: Use OAuth 2.0 Authorization for Secure Access to OData Services

590833814.text:
To allow importing entities from SAP S/4HANA Cloud with the new import wizard, you can now enable the Model Import feature for SAP S/4HANA Cloud connections.
See [SAP S/4HANA Cloud Connections](a98e5ffdf47c44d9a845dca01a18bd82.html).
590833814.title: Enable Model Import for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Connections

590833815.text:
From the Remote Table Monitor – Detail screen, you now have the possibility to split your remote table data into smaller partitions, and thus enable more efficient data transfer of large datasets from SAP HANA smart data access sources.
See [Partitioning Remote Table Data Loads](a218d2715fd54b71a0b2060f4f97cf20.html).
590833815.title: Create Partitions For Your Remote Tables Connected With an SAP HANA Smart Data Access Adapter

590833816.text:
You can now delete delta share data products.
See [Creating Data Products for SAP Business Data Cloud](b07e95d07a1e4569b87d9bb57b732bcf.html).
590833816.title: Custom Delta Share Data Products Deletion

590833817.text:
When creating a new data product, the Artifact Space selection is now located at the top of the page.
See [Creating Marketplace Data Products](bbcbf42b0cb541529e63628d95f394c8.html).
590833817.title: Space Selection during Data Product Creation

590833818.text:
You can use the command line interface to install data products for consumers.
See [Managing Data Marketplace Data Products via the Command Line](34e88f7889734b1691fab7d8715c17fa.html).
590833818.title: Manage Data Products via the Command Line

590833819.text:
As a data provider using a SAP Business Data Cloud tenant, you can create dedicated data products to bring data coming from the Data Product Generator in the BW Systems into SAP Databricks.
See [Creating Data Products for SAP Business Data Cloud](b07e95d07a1e4569b87d9bb57b732bcf.html).
590833819.title: Create Data Products for SAP Databricks

590833820.text:
Access to features and functionality for the catalog and data marketplace have been unified under a single access point in the side navigation. Users can select  (Catalog & Marketplace) to access the catalog:
- Search for and evaluate data and assets in the catalog (see [Discovering Data Products and Assets in the Catalog](6df42e3675324d73bd35c2e70d46a7ee.html))
- Manage their marketplace data products installations, activate licenses, and choose contexts they want to be a member of (see [Managing Marketplace Data Products](5d725beb848e432a91eb8de29875d7e2.html))
- Connect and manage source systems and monitor metadata extraction (see [Connecting Source Systems](0b5de87f256f466f95b46d4bcaa52640.html))
590833820.title: Unify the Side Navigation for Catalog and Data Marketplace

590833821.text:
You can use the Data Sharing Cockpit REST APIs to manage data provider tasks.
See [Managing the Data Marketplace via the REST API](59768ad8c8054d2db92fdf545b0a2485.html).
590833821.title: Data Sharing Cockpit REST APIs

590833822.text:
You can use the Datarade data finder website to search and request additional third-party data products from various data providers.
See [Searching for Data Products and Assets in the Catalog](10478251045b43e782fa15e0f3e113b0.html).
590833822.title: Access third-party data from Datarade

590833823.text: You can now use artifacts containing input parameters in data products.See [Creating Marketplace Data Products](bbcbf42b0cb541529e63628d95f394c8.html).
590833823.title: Enable Input Parameters for Data Products

590833824.text:
You can now duplicate existing data products.
See [Duplicating Data Products](14232081d7444195b1f66c16e56f6d09.html).
590833824.title: Duplicating Data Products

590833825.text:
You can now manage Data Marketplace licenses, releases, and contexts using the command line.
See:
- [Managing Data Marketplace Licenses via the Command Line](39ea782902c444fdb3f350cc4c19b4bc.html)
- [Managing Data Marketplace Releases via the Command Line](2199031b1ee84f7999e98537a5d44e44.html)
- [Managing Data Marketplace Contexts via the Command Line](b90ff75d933546ad81891f73b681820f.html)
590833825.title: CLI Commands for Licenses, Releases, and Contexts

590833826.text:
Allow users to consume data products directly from the Data Marketplace using OpenSQL access.
See [Enabling OpenSQL Access](afae5a2de300472794c69b58ce670b2e.html).
590833826.title: OpenSQL Access

590833827.text:
Use the Internal Data Marketplace to enable all the users of a tenant to acquire data products internally. Indeed, create Internal Data Marketplace contexts to build up an internal data exchange with consumers from the same tenant, or from a list of specified tenants.
See [Using Contexts to Realize Public, Private, and Internal Offers](c936499e7ef045b09139723fd0ac9e09.html).
590833827.title: Internal Data Marketplace

590833828.text:
With this release you can use the command line interface, dwc, to create, read, update, and modify data providers and data products. You can create new data providers and data products in mass operations, or update properties, such as pricing information, publishing status, or context assignments of data products. It is also possible to list all data providers or data products you have access to.
See:
- [Managing Data Marketplace Data Products via the Command Line](34e88f7889734b1691fab7d8715c17fa.html)
- [Managing Data Marketplace Data Providers via the Command Line](ca9f910607da4a9e8a2385f655edab95.html)
590833828.title: Using the Command Line Interface for Data Marketplace for Data Provider and Data Product (Mass) Operations

590833829.text: Users of Data Marketplace will now find a correlation ID and an error code in error messages. This additional technical information can help SAP support engineers to resolve incidents.
590833829.title: Correlation ID in Error Messages

590833830.text:
With this new feature data providers are now able to define and limit who can see their data products. You can now publish your data products in private contexts. Then your data products are not available publicly any longer. You can invite consumers to join your own context to be members in your private data marketplace. You can also invite other data providers to publish their data products in your context to create a wider offering.
With the introduction of context management, all existing data providers profiles will be set to type Public Data Provider and all existing data products will be assigned to the context SAP Data Marketplace. When creating new data products you have to specify the context where they will be published.
For data providers, see [Using Contexts to Realize Public, Private, and Internal Offers](c936499e7ef045b09139723fd0ac9e09.html).
For consumers, see [Managing Marketplace Data Products](5d725beb848e432a91eb8de29875d7e2.html).
590833830.title: Context Management

590833831.text:
It is now possible for data providers to deactivate and delete data products if they fulfill certain conditions. Before it was only possible to delist them.
See [Deleting a Data Product](c0463f0978204df0b267ff4990edde70.html).
590833831.title: Deactivating and Deleting Data Products

590833832.text:
In the new section Usage Overview data providers can find recent and overall numbers on active and expired licenses, activations and updates. The numbers are helpful to data providers when they want to know more about the usage of their data products. Data providers need these number also when they want to clean their product portfolio and delete data products from it.
See [Managing your Data Product's Lifecycle](c400001264094f8c89da104db72514ad.html).
590833832.title: New section Usage Overview on the data product's details page

590833833.text:
This release simplifies the selection of a space. Data Providers will find this enhanced function in the Create Data Product screen, while consumers will find it in the Load Data Product screen.
When you click on the new icon which you can find next to the space input field, you will get a list with all spaces you have access to. Now you can select the space easily from the list. If you prefer to type the name of the space, you will receive auto-suggests while typing.
See:
- [Creating Marketplace Data Products](bbcbf42b0cb541529e63628d95f394c8.html)
- [Installing Marketplace Data Products](92c35efd6a4945a1a78250539aee9a51.html)
590833833.title: Enhanced Space Selection

590833834.text:
Data Marketplace is the new easy-to-use platform to exchange diverse, fine-grain data in SAP Data Warehouse Cloud. Each customer of SAP Data Warehouse Cloud can now become their own data publisher and monetize their existing data.
Note that Data Marketplace and the Data Sharing Cockpit are only available in SAP Data Warehouse Cloud tenants provisioned since January 25, 2021 (see [3148585](https://me.sap.com/notes/3148585)).
590833834.title: General Availability of Data Marketplace

590833835.text:
The Data Sharing Cockpit is the tool you use as a data provider. As a data provider, your main objective is to offer valuable data products to the users of the Data Marketplace in SAP Data Warehouse Cloud. To manage your products and licenses, to publish new releases, and to maintain your data provider profile page, the Data Sharing Cockpit offers you tailored apps for each task and workflow.
See [Data Sharing Cockpit - Data Provider's Guide](e479b7b4c95741c7a7a1d42397984c7e.html).
590833835.title: Provide and Sell Data Products with the Data Sharing Cockpit

590833836.text: You can now use task ports to provide enhanced flexibility and error handling in task chains. Task ports allow you the control the flow of task based on success or failure outcomes. Additionally, the new Ignore Error feature allows you to disregard the status of a specific task from the overall task chain status evaluation. This feature is beneficial for maintaining workflow continuity, managing errors effectively, and customizing task execution paths. See [Select Task Ports in a Task Chain](04dcfa7fcf374e8798c9807cfe612c0c.html)
590833836.title: Select Task Ports in Task Chains

590833837.text:
You can now use the syntax ?$select=<DimensionName> with the consumption/analytical API to obtain lists of unique dimension values for your analytic model. If you specify two or more dimension names then you obtain a list of unique combinations of dimension values.
See [Consuming Data via the OData API](7a453609c8694b029493e7d87e0de60a.html).
590833837.title: OData API: Obtain Lists of Values for Analytic Model Dimensions

590833838.text: When a Data Builder object has been changed, saved, and deployed again, the status of any deployed analytic model that uses that object changes to either Changes to Deploy or Design Time Error, depending on which change has been made.
590833838.title: Impact of Changes in the Source of an Analytic Model

590833839.text:
The Data Warehouse Data Builder (-R------) is no longer required for users who connect to SAP Datasphere to consume data exposed from a space. Now such consumers need only be granted the following scoped privileges for the spaces to which they need access:
- Data Warehouse Consumption (-R------) - To access data exposed by SAP Datasphere spaces.
- Space Files (-R------) - To access objects in spaces.
The DW Consumer role template, for example, grants these privileges, and is intended for users who will only consume data and do not need to connect to SAP Datasphere itself.
See [Consuming Data via the OData API](7a453609c8694b029493e7d87e0de60a.html).
590833839.title: Simplified Consumption Privileges

590833840.text:
You can now import shapefile data to provide custom choropleth layers for use in visualizations of geographical data.
Note
SAP Datasphere tenants provisioned up to and including version v2025.23 provide default choropleth shapefile data. Tenants provisioned since then no longer include this data, but you can manually install it.
See [Enable Choropleth Layers for Geographical Visualizations](4e45d4cb71404f52bd3cb01676f328e1.html).
590833840.title: Custom Choropleth Layers

590833841.text:
You can define input parameters on the task level of task chains. You can also create new input parameters in task chains. This will allow for more flexible usage of task chains and nested task chains.
See: [Create Input Parameters in Task Chains](c9906ec515f04fbd9589c59339b03c6c.html).
590833841.title: Creating Input Parameters in Task Chains and Nested Task Chains

590833842.text: You can use local tables shared from an SAP HANA space and shared remote tables on a Delta Share runtime as sources for a transformation flow in a file space. See [Creating a Transformation Flow in a File Space](b917baf0431343bea8381fa37e12eeb8.html).
590833842.title: Using Shared Local Tables and Shared Remote Tables on a Delta Share Runtime as Sources in a Transformation Flow in a File Space

590833843.text:
When your data flow is eligible to be converted into a transformation flow or a replication flow coupled with a transformation flow, a banner will be displayed in the data flow editor. Using a replication flow and/or a transformation flow will allow you to benefit from improved connectivity, access to delta load processing, and enhanced resiliency and scalability.
See [Use Replication Flows and Transformation Flows to Load and Write Data](34ae0a2ea6e94483b19f632a2843d56d.html)
590833843.title: Convert an Existing Data Flow Into a Replication Flow and/or a Transformation Flow

590833844.text: Create an input parameter to prompt the user to enter a value for use in filtering or other calculations when the transformation flow is run. This feature is available for transformation flows in SAP HANA runtime and Apache Spark runtime. For more information, see [Creating a Transformation Flow](f7161e6c20204672ac4a6d90c81762e4.html).
590833844.title: Creating Input Parameters in a Transformation Flow

590833845.text: Logically group data into batches based on specific column values in a transformation flow on file's Python Operator. Batches provide greater control over data processing for transformation flow on file and helps users manage data skew and optimize batch selection by offering new metrics like total, maximum, minimum, and average batch sizes in the Run Details. See [Metrics for Transformation Flows](b42fa5b6f4e04a9491efa9bf7dab0929.html).
590833845.title: Transformation Flow on File: User-Defined Data Batching in Python Operator

590833846.text:
You can now define OAuth clients with a Technical User purpose to provide access to the OData consumption APIs based on the roles and scopes you assign directly to the client. See:
- [Create an OAuth2.0 Client with a Technical User Purpose](88b13468fc3c4ebd972bcb8faa6cafbf.html)
- [Consuming Data via the OData API](7a453609c8694b029493e7d87e0de60a.html)
590833846.title: OAuth Technical User Clients for OData Consumption APIs

590833847.text: When you add an analytic model as a source to your new analytic model, you can now change the mapping type to Set Value for variables to a fixed value or interval/ range.
590833847.title: Mapping Types for Variables in the Analytic Model

590833848.text:
You can now use the new Fiscal Time dimension type to model your fiscal time periods and the columns that define their starts and ends.See:
- [Create a Dimension to Categorize Data](5aae0e95361a4a4c964e69c52eada87d.html)
- [Add a Fiscal Time Dimension](6d1ff7426b6342d7892697407bded26f.html)
590833848.title: Fiscal Time Dimensions

590833849.text: The transformation flow's Impact and Lineage graph allows you to visualize column lineage for target and source nodes. See [Creating a Transformation Flow](f7161e6c20204672ac4a6d90c81762e4.html).
590833849.title: Column Lineage for Transformation Flows

590833850.text: A new validation rule, can help resolve the problem of dimensions, text entities, or hierarchies that do not provide unique values for identifying records when navigated to via an association.See [Validating View Data](ed4063dc7f53436d806ea48f2fd3949a.html).
590833850.title: Data Validation: Unique Association Target Values

590833851.text:
If your SAP Datasphere tenant is part of an SAP Business Data Cloud you can now use the Allow Data Transport switch to authorize the transport of data along with your local table dimensions.See:
- [Creating a Local Table](2509fe4d86aa472b9858164b55b38077.html)
- [Create a Dimension to Categorize Data](5aae0e95361a4a4c964e69c52eada87d.html)
- [Creating Packages to Export](24aba84ceeb3416881736f70f02e3a0a.html)
590833851.title: Transport Master Data in Local Table Dimensions

590833852.text: You can now define measures with exception aggregation based on time showing proper values even if there are no booked values with exception aggregation types FIRST OF DIMENSION, AVERAGE OF DIMENSION, and LAST OF DIMENSION.
590833852.title: Exception Aggregation Enhancements

590833853.text: Derived values are now also available for filter variables and restricted measure variables. See [Derived Variables](82f40f73bbbf42a283648fa312a5aec2.html).
590833853.title: Derived Values for Variables

590833854.text: Handle incremental data loads and maintain aggregated results efficiently with incremental aggregations. See [Creating a Transformation Flow in a File Space](b917baf0431343bea8381fa37e12eeb8.html).
590833854.title: Transformation Flow in File Space - Incremental Aggregations

590833855.text: You can now request SAP Datasphere to suggest a Semantic Usage for your entity, identify measures and attributes, and apply appropriate semantic types to them.See [Generate Semantic Information](2fc1d26ebff748e4905d724247d33531.html).
590833855.title: Identify and Generate Semantic Information for Facts, Dimensions, and Text Entities

590833856.text: Syntax errors in SQL sources are marked with line numbers in the message pane and/or highlighting on the erroneous line in the editor.
590833856.title: SQL View Editor Improvements

590833857.text: You can now obtain the correctly formed OData service route for any asset directly from the Generate OData Request dialog in the asset editor.See [Consuming Data via the OData API](7a453609c8694b029493e7d87e0de60a.html).
590833857.title: Obtain OData Service Route for an Asset

590833858.text:
A new validation rule, run from a fact view, can help resolve the problem of records in the fact that are not assigned to any node in an associated hierarchy with directory (and which consequently cause inaccuracies in your aggregations and visualizations). It can:
- Identifies hierarchy nodes that are missing for records in the fact.
- Generate entities that allocate these records to a new Unassigned node and make this node available for display in your aggregations and visualizations.
See [Validating View Data](ed4063dc7f53436d806ea48f2fd3949a.html).
590833858.title: Data Validation: Missing Hierarchy Nodes

590833859.text:
You can now use natural language to search for objects based on the tables, views and analytic models in their lineage and impacts.For example, entering all views using table Sales will return a list of all views that have a table with a name like Sales in their lineage.
See [Natural Language Search](04170c64c1004fc58d7f235aea0e4970.html).
590833859.title: Search for Objects by Their Lineage and Impacts Using Natural Language

590833860.text: [Creating a Transformation Flow in a File Space](b917baf0431343bea8381fa37e12eeb8.html).
590833860.title: Drag and Drop Feature for Transformation Flow on File

590833861.text: When you perform data deletion for your local table (file) either from the Table Editor or the Task Chain editor, you can override the default Apache Spark Application Settings that were defined at space creation by your administrator.See [Creating a Task Chain](d1afbc2b9ee84d44a00b0b777ac243e1.html) and [Deleting Local Table (File) Records](6ec9b8a89dc64b5cac069cee81399c92.html).
590833861.title: Override Default Apache Spark Application Settings in Table Editor and Task Chain for Local Tables (File)

590833862.text:
You can now make calls to the OData consumption APIs with the $batch syntax, which is used by SAP Build and SAP Fiori Elements Apps as well as other data consumers.Note
SAP Datasphere restricts the contents of the body of a $batch request to a single GET request. Additional requests are not supported.
See [Consuming Data via the OData API](7a453609c8694b029493e7d87e0de60a.html)
590833862.title: OData <samp class="ph codeph">$batch</samp> Syntax

590833863.text: You can now select additional data types for your local table (file): DateTime, hana.BINARY and hana.TINYINT.See [Data Types Supported By Local Tables (File)](2f39104e5bd847919b8daee1580c4f68.html)
590833863.title: New Data Types Supported for Local Tables (File)

590833864.text:
For variables with filter type Range in analytic models, you can now define several value ranges.
For variables with filter type Multiple Single Values, you can now define default values with multiple rows.
See: [Create a Filter Variable](8683b49e60c643f4947da11b5aa31585.html)
590833864.title: Options for Filter Variables in the Analytic Model

590833865.text:
You can now use natural language to search for tables, views, analytic models and Business Builder For example, entering Tables with a measure called sales id will return a list of all tables containing such a measure.
See [Natural Language Search](04170c64c1004fc58d7f235aea0e4970.html).
590833865.title: Search for Objects by Their Contents Using Natural Language

590833866.text: From the Data Builder, when creating your local table, you can define partitions based on one or several columns of your table to break your data down into smaller and more manageable parts. You can now choose between range partitioning or hash partitioning.See [Partitioning Local Tables](03191f36e9144b2aaa47b8c9eea039c1.html)
590833866.title: Partition Your Local Table Data With Hash Partitioning

590833867.text: You can now change the format of a measure (decimal places and scale) in an analytic model in the Formatting section in the editor.
590833867.title: Format of Measures

590833868.text: You can display an impact and lineage analysis for measures in the analytic model.
590833868.title: Impact and Lineage Analysis for Measures

590833869.text: A new validation rule helps you ensure that all values in foreign key columns in fact views are present in the key columns of the associated dimensions. See [Validating View Data](ed4063dc7f53436d806ea48f2fd3949a.html).
590833869.title: Data Validation: Referential Integrity

590833870.text: You can now run data validations on views with remote sources (where this is supported by the connection adapter and the rule). You are warned before starting the validation, and have the option to cancel validation at any time.See [Validating View Data](ed4063dc7f53436d806ea48f2fd3949a.html).
590833870.title: Data Validation: Support for Remote Sources

590833871.text: A selection of Python standard libraries can be used in a transformation flow on file python operator. See [Python Operator Reference](950d55834dee450c9f71786d8b14a634.html).
590833871.title: Transformation Flow on File: Support for Python Standard Libraries

590833872.text: When creating a replication flow, you can select the new option Merge Data Automatically: It will start an automatic merge activity to update your target local table (file) with new data. See [Creating a Replication Flow](25e2bd7a70d44ac5b05e844f9e913471.html).
590833872.title: Automate a Merge Activity While Creating a Replication Flow

590833873.text: In the analytic model, the function GrandTotal is now available for expressions for calculated measures.
590833873.title: GrandTotal for Calculated Measures

590833874.text: In the analytic model, you can now combine static (hierarchies and single values) and dynamic filter based (operator and values) Data Access Controls.
590833874.title: Combining Data Access Controls

590833875.text: Increase the performance and storage efficiency of Local Tables (File) by deleting obsolete versions of data that have already been processed by flows. See [Deleting Local Table (File) Records](6ec9b8a89dc64b5cac069cee81399c92.html).
590833875.title: Delete Local Table (File) Data From Previous Versions

590833876.text: Annotations indicating the semantic types of columns are now provided when you retrieve the metadata for an asset.See [Consuming Data via the OData API](7a453609c8694b029493e7d87e0de60a.html).
590833876.title: Semantic Type Annotations in OData

590833877.text: After a dimension has been saved or deployed after performing changes to a hierarchy, the status of any deployed analytic model that use that dimension changed to either Changes to Deploy or Design Time Error, depending on which change has been made.
590833877.title: Impact of Changes in the Source of an Analytic Model

590833878.text: You can now apply Data Access Controls to the analytic model to protect it directly without dependency on its fact source authorizations.See [Apply a Data Access Control to an Analytic Model](8d8e2f9b36a74de3b6f5f1384ad8f70d.html).
590833878.title: Data Access Controls for Analytic Models

590833879.text: You can define dynamic default values for variables in analytic models. The value can then be proposed dynamically in the analytic preview and in the SAP Analytics Cloud variable prompt.See [Create a Standard Variable](8a2978ed34de4d0d975ebdd1bbf96ac4.html) and [Create a Reference Date Variable](a2d060ee364440dab656557ba42c20b4.html).
590833879.title: Dynamic Default Values for Variables

590833880.text: SAP Analytics Cloud users can save their planning and analytic model data directly in SAP Datasphere spaces. The SAP Analytics Cloud users can choose for each object, whether to expose it to SAP Datasphere modelers for use as sources for views, flows, and analytic models.See [Store and Consume SAP Analytics Cloud Data in SAP Datasphere](fe958749e31e4130874713cb722cd255.html).
590833880.title: Seamless Planning

590833881.text:
From the table editor, some enhancements have been made to help you with housekeeping on already processed data changes. For local tables where delta capture is enabled, you can now delete records as follows:
- Delete all records: All records containted in your table will be physically deleted.
- Delete all records (Mark as "Deleted)= All records contained in your table will take the change type "D" but can still be processed by other apps until they are permanently deleted.
- Delete all records marked for deletion which are older than the specified number of days: Based on the defined number of days, all fully-processed records with change type "D" will be permanently deleted.
See [Load or Delete Local Table Data](870401f211f94132909bd9f2fafd91b2.html)
590833881.title: Delete Records From Your Delta Capture Local Table

590833882.text: You can now enter your Repository Explorer or Data Builder search string in natural language and SAP Datasphere will interpret your phrase and filter your results appropriately. See [Natural Language Search](04170c64c1004fc58d7f235aea0e4970.html).
590833882.title: Natural Language Search

590833883.text: You can now can enter technical names for dimensions and duplicated attributes in the editor of the analytic model. The label Dimension Alias has been renamed to Business Name. For more information, see [Add a Dimension to an Analytic Model](4caf0987e7c7460e878fb574f04bd6a4.html).
590833883.title: Technical Names for Dimensions and Attributes

590833884.text:
Previously, hierarchies could only be identified in the hierarchy directory by a single key column, which was specified in the Hierarchy Name Column property. This property is now renamed to Hierarchy Directory Association. It must contain the association pointing to the hierarchy directory and supports associations with compound keys. Existing hierarchies will be migrated automatically to the new format.
See [Create a Hierarchy with Directory](36c39eee184c485a80ebce9d0fec49ec.html).
590833884.title: Hierarchy as Directory with Compound Keys

590833885.text: You can now specify the language in which to return data from analytic models via the OData API. See [Consuming Data via the OData API](7a453609c8694b029493e7d87e0de60a.html).
590833885.title: OData Language Parameter

590833886.text:
You can now review a list of past versions of objects, and:
- Open a past version in read-only mode.
- Download a past version to a CSN/JSON file.
- Restore a past version to replace the current version (views, analytic models, and local tables only).
See [Reviewing and Restoring Object Versions](4f717cc0d90e4453a072b37f6b043593.html).
590833886.title: Review and Restore Object Versions

590833887.text: You can now change the order of variables in the editor of an analytic model by drag&drop. This order will be taken into account in the data preview and in the prompt in SAP Analytics Cloud.
590833887.title: Order of Variables in Analytic Model

590833888.text:
You can now navigate to entities used in the analytic model from the properties panel and from error messages via links.
Your navigation steps are now included in the URL, which means you can easily share a link to a specific object to other users in your company.
590833888.title: Navigation within and to the Analytic Model

590833889.text: The new Export Support Information in the Data Viewer toolbar generates a file containing technical information to send to SAP support.See [Viewing Object Data](b338e4aa7e7e494eb68c383720ebfd3a.html).
590833889.title: Data Viewer Support File

590833890.text: Remote tables can now consume SAP HANA calculation view with input parameters.See [Review and Edit Imported Table Properties](75cea7b1cbeb4c9dba0ac13605c527b3.html).
590833890.title: Remote Tables Support SAP HANA Calculation Views With Input Parameters.

590833891.text: You can specify a custom prefix or suffix for the technical name of attributes. See [Add a Prefix or a Suffix to Dimension Attributes](0373c60d7e614dd5b5189de767bb672b.html).
590833891.title: Attributes in Analytic Models

590833892.text: Previously, it was not possible to view data in a view that is shared from another space if the view contained input parameters. This restriction is now removed.See [Viewing Object Data](b338e4aa7e7e494eb68c383720ebfd3a.html).
590833892.title: View Data in Shared Views Containing Input Parameters

590833893.text: In the data preview of the analytic model, you can now export the data as an Excel or CSV file. This enables you to share the intermediate results with colleagues, and to validate the calculations and measures.
590833893.title: Export Data from Analytic Model

590833894.text:
Previously, when working with content packages, you were restricted to importing into spaces with the same technical name as the spaces listed in the package. Now you can choose which spaces to import into by selecting a Space Mapping for each space listed in your package, so long as any shared objects can be resolved in the same package.See:
- [Importing Content from Another Tenant](b607a12931d74c4a93506ea64c55ab4e.html)
- [Importing SAP and Partner Business Content from the Content Network](400078d689bf4454b3fc977a4e201c2f.html)
590833894.title: Select Space to Import Package

590833895.text: You can now configure your OData requests directly from the analytic model and graphical and SQL view editors, including providing values for variables, input parameters, and OData parameters. Your request is automatically generated and can be copied directly or downloaded in OpenAPI request format.See [Consuming Data via the OData API](7a453609c8694b029493e7d87e0de60a.html).
590833895.title: Configure OData Requests from Asset Editors

590833896.text: The E/R model editor now allows you to view data for any diagram entity with support for rich sorting and filtering.See [Viewing Object Data](b338e4aa7e7e494eb68c383720ebfd3a.html).
590833896.title: E/R Model Data Viewer

590833897.text:
To encourage confidence in the stability of your views and to guarantee backward compatibility when they are updated, you can set their Release State to Released. Once a view is released, it must continue to provide the same output columns until it is replaced by a successor, at which point it can be deprecated and, eventually, decommissioned.
See [Releasing Stable Views for Consumption](5b99e9bcb5964ab69b094215d285feb1.html).
590833897.title: Release Stable Views for Consumption

590833898.text:
We have introduced a new validation framework to help you to validate the data output by your views. In this version, we include initial validation rules to check the consistency of your key columns and hierarchy nodes.
See [Validating View Data](ed4063dc7f53436d806ea48f2fd3949a.html).
590833898.title: Data Validation

590833899.text:
For the analytic model, we have improved the user experience:
You can now copy existing measures to create a new measure.
For measures, attributes and associated dimensions there is now a Select All/Unselect All checkbox.
590833899.title: Improved User Experience for Analytic Model

590833900.text:
When one or more packages is available in your space, modelers can now a state that is not changing every day. See package directly from the relevant editor:
- Business entity
- Fact model
- Consumption model
- Authorization Scenario
See [Packages](a806c67ed11749c788142775d2cc2494.html).
590833900.title: Package Field in Additional Editors

590833901.text: When one or more packages is available in your space, modelers can now a state[Create a Non-Cumulative Measure](58fcee02df8044119777cf060000aca8.html) .
590833901.title: Measure Type Non-Cumulative Measure for Analytic Models

590833902.text: When you create a data flow and the data source come from Open Connectors, you can define filter conditions to apply on the data.See [Add a Source to a Data Flow](7b50e8e304244ced9ff1e62e2f2fe919.html)
590833902.title: Define Filter Conditions While Creating a Data Flow When Your Data Source Come From Open Connectors

590833903.text: When an association in the underlying views or tables of an analytic model is changed or deleted, you can still save the analytic model, but you get an error message and the status of the analytic model changes to design time error.
590833903.title: Changes to Associations in the Analytic Model

590833904.text:
The Impact and Lineage Analysis viewer now allows you to select one or more columns in your analyzed object and show their sources and the columns that they impact.
See [Impact and Lineage Analysis](9da4892cb0e4427ab80ad8d89e6676b8.html).
590833904.title: Column Lineage

590833905.text: If your SAP S/4HANA Cloud connection supports using replication flows to load data to local tables, the Import Entities dialog will now default to this data access setting.See [Importing Entities with Semantics from SAP S/4HANA](845fedbd28574aa8b84239df848936f6.html).
590833905.title: Import Entities from SAP S/4HANA Cloud via Replication Flows

590833906.text: If a local table with delta capture enabled is used in a replication flow or a transformation flow, information is now displayed in the Dependent Objects of the local table.See [Review the Objects That Depend on Your Table or View](ecac5fdf2a81435fa6dbd51975e8416d.html)
590833906.title: Enhancement of Dependent Objects for Tables with Delta Capture Enabled

590833907.text: The improved Select Object dialog provides new filtering options to help you quickly find your required object when creating associations and doing other tasks that require you to select an object from your space. This new dialog is available when creating an association, a text association, applying a data access control, and adding related entities to an E/R model diagram.
590833907.title: Improved Object Selection Experience

590833908.text: In cases where multiple associations and/or text association are defined on a single attribute in a fact or dimension, you can now specify which association (or local text attribute) should be used for each attribute when analytic models consume your entity.See [Specify Attributes as Keys, Units, and Other Characteristics](cedc59c994cf488bb6b43b105e72c4d3.html).
590833908.title: Improved Consumption of Associations in Analytic Models

590833909.text: In the analytic model, you can now use variables which derive their value through a lookup entity.
590833909.title: Derived Variables

590833910.text: We have improved the user experience for the analytic model. Apart from smaller adjustments, semantic information for fact source measures is displayed. On the entry page of the analytic model editor, the deployment date is now displayed. You can now delete multiple dimensions at once. In the details for analytic models, measures, attributes, and variables, the dependencies are now displayed.
590833910.title: Improved User Experience for Analytic Model

590833911.text: In addition to Remote Table Replication, View Persistency, Intelligent Lookup, Data Flow, and Transformation Flow tasks, you can now also nest other task chains within a task chain.
590833911.title: Nested Task Chains

590833912.text: You can define default values for each remote table parameter. See [Review and Edit Imported Table Properties](75cea7b1cbeb4c9dba0ac13605c527b3.html)
590833912.title: Default Values for Remote Tables Input Parameters

590833913.text: Validations for analytic models using level based hierarchies have been improved. Some analytic models may now raise an error message and require adaptation.
590833913.title: Validation of Analytic Models

590833914.text: The import of SAP BW∕4HANA models is now integrated in the Import Entities wizard, which can be accessed from the Data Builder and the Repository Explorer. With the import via the Import Entities wizard, you can now also import InfoProviders besides analytic queries.See [Importing Entities with Semantics from SAP BW∕4HANA or SAP BW Bridge](7bcd3218b4064b898ca367b47ff246e2.html).
590833914.title: Import of SAP BW∕4HANA Models

590833915.text: When you delete records in a local table that is delta capture enabled, records take the value "change type = deleted" but they are not physically deleted from the database to allow running flows that can transfer the deletion information to further targets. Once they have been fully processed, you can safely delete these records within a task chain or a using the Delete Data from Table in the Data Builder.See [Load or Delete Local Table Data](870401f211f94132909bd9f2fafd91b2.html) and [Creating a Task Chain](d1afbc2b9ee84d44a00b0b777ac243e1.html)
590833915.title: Local Table with Delta Capture Enabled: Delete Fully-Processed Records Marked as Deleted

590833916.text:
When one or more packages is available in your space, modelers can now add further types of objects to a package directly from the relevant editor:
- Data flow
- Replication flow
- Transformation flow
- Task chain
- Intelligent lookup
See [Packages](a806c67ed11749c788142775d2cc2494.html).
590833916.title: Package Field in Additional Editors

590833917.text:
When one or more packages is available in your space, modelers can now add further types of objects to a package directly from the relevant editor:
- Data access control
See [Packages](a806c67ed11749c788142775d2cc2494.html).
590833917.title: Package Field in Additional Editors

590833918.text:
The new Repository tab of the Source Browser shows all the tables, views, and intelligent lookups in your space in a single list and lets you filter by collection (All, Recent, My Objects, Shared, Favorites). You can modify the sorting, perform complex filtering, and drill down into folders, as well as previewing properties and data before adding your source.
See [Using the Source Browser](7d2b21d974e44bdc9d548cf7532b5a43.html).
590833918.title: Improved Data Builder Source Browser

590833919.text: Business Builder objects are now listed alongside Data Builder objects in the Repository Explorer (while remaining accessible via the Business Builder).See [Repository Explorer](f8ce0b4a24fe473a962176c8aa3cad42.html).
590833919.title: Business Builder Objects in the Repository Explorer

590833920.text: If your remote table consumes parameterized Hana SQL views using SAP HANA smart data access as source, the parameters are displayed with their properties in the table editor.See [Review and Edit Imported Table Properties](75cea7b1cbeb4c9dba0ac13605c527b3.html)
590833920.title: Remote Tables Now Consume Entities With Input Parameters

590833921.text: Identify available table structure updates for all tables sharing the same source connection, and resolve conflicting errors resulting from these updates.See [Process Source Changes for Several Remote Tables](4e0be1612c9147069d0cddc9c6201455.html).
590833921.title: Identify Source Changes for Several Tables Sharing the Same Connection

590833922.text: When creating a variable for an analytic model, or an expression for a restricted measure, you now get a value help with possible values.
590833922.title: Value Help in the Analytic Model Editor

590833923.text: The deployment state is now shown in the object status including changes to dependent objects. After a change in a dimension that requires redeployment of the analytic model, you can now deploy it from the Data Builder landing page. You can even select several analytic models and deploy them in one go.
590833923.title: Deployment Status of Analytic Model

590833924.text:
You can now list modeling objects of any type in your space, and read and delete individual objects from the command line using the following commands:
- datasphere objects <object-type> list --space <id>
- datasphere objects <object-type> read --space <id> --technical-name <name>
- datasphere objects <object-type> delete --space <id> --technical-name <name>
See [Manage Modeling Objects and Tasks via the Command Line](6f5c65f209004751aa48f9682ee2ec45.html).
590833924.title: Read and Delete Modeling Objects via the Command Line

590833925.text: Users with space administrator privileges can create packages to model groups of related objects for transport between tenants. Modelers can add objects to packages via the Package field, which appears in editors when a package is created in their space. Once a package is complete and validated, the space administrator can export it to the Content Network. The structure of your package is preserved and, as the objects it contains evolve, you can easily export updated versions of it. See [Packages](a806c67ed11749c788142775d2cc2494.html) and [Creating Packages to Export](24aba84ceeb3416881736f70f02e3a0a.html).
590833925.title: Package Modeling

590833926.text:
You can now model hierarchies with directories. These types of hierarchy entities can include nodes from multiple dimensions (for example, country, cost center group, and cost center) and are commonly imported from SAP S/4HANA Cloud and SAP BW systems.
See [Create a Hierarchy with Directory](36c39eee184c485a80ebce9d0fec49ec.html)
590833926.title: Hierarchy with Directory

590833927.text: You can save a SQL View even if it contains errors so as to keep your changes for future corrections. Save your view as usual and then click Save Anyway.
590833927.title: Saving SQL Views with Errors

590833928.text: You can now create partitions based on one column of your local table to break your data down into smaller tables, and better manage tables with large volume of data.See [Partitioning Local Tables](03191f36e9144b2aaa47b8c9eea039c1.html).
590833928.title: Partition Your Local Table

590833929.text:
In a graphical view, when using a filter, calculated column, or, in some cases, an aggregation node, you can get help inserting values in a SQL expression in the expression editor.
See:
- [Create a Calculated Column in a Graphical View](3897f480b9404e6f82de9bba410f17c0.html)
- [Filter Data in a Graphical View](6f6fa18c7c9444da8ca62d76656b7b1a.html)
- [Aggregate Data in a Graphical View](7733250f9d2a46b690a5288634d269f0.html)
590833929.title: Get Assistance when Inserting Values in the Graphical View Expression Editor

590833930.text:
A new Fact semantic usage is available, and the Analytical Dataset semantic usage is deprecated.The preferred way to expose data to SAP Analytics Cloud is now to identify your measures in a table or view with a semantic usage of Fact and then to use this fact in one or more analytic models, each of which can be consumed by one or more stories (see [Creating an Analytic Model](e5fbe9e2cb93484dab8b1963145e565f.html)).
This new workflow provides the following benefits: Feature Analytical Dataset Fact + Analytic Model Aggregations Standard aggregations only, such as SUM, COUNT. Standard and post-aggregation measures (calculated measures, restricted measures, and count distinct measures), including support for exception aggregations.Move post-aggregation measures from your SAP Analytics Cloud stories into your analytic models to benefit from real-time previewing of results and to promote re-use.
Measures and attribute selection All measures and attributes and first-level dimension always exposed to SAP Analytics Cloud. More remote dimensions cannot be included. Model as many measures, attributes, and associations to dimensions as appropriate in a fact, and then choose to expose only those that you need in each analytic model. You can select attributes from any dimension that is associated with the fact, whether it is a first-level dimension (directly associated with the fact) or any dimension that can be reached by following further associations. Data viewer Relational data viewer shows lists of records Rich analytic viewer, based on the SAP Analytics Cloud Data Analyzer, supports measure and attribute selection, filtering and pivoting, and hierarchy support​.
See [Create a Fact to Contain Measurable Data](30089bd2aa754ab996a62cf5842ae60a.html) and [Analytical Datasets (Deprecated)](70dab71147834c20b98ead017d7c5d8a.html).
590833930.title: New Fact Semantic Usage (and Deprecation of Analytical Dataset)

590833931.text: From the table editor of the Data Builder, you can now change the remote table connection, the remote table source object, or create a copy of an existing table with the Save As option. See [Modify or Duplicate Remote Tables](8c3632f28dc94e068dbdab8fe9bbeeb9.html).
590833931.title: Modify or Duplicate Remote Tables

590833932.text: You can now create currency conversion measures in the analytic model.
590833932.title: Currency Conversion in Analytic Model

590833933.text: You can now use the Image URL semantic type to identify a dimension attribute as containing a URL pointing to an image file. The image will be displayed when you show the attribute in an SAP Analytics Cloud story.See [Specify Semantic Types for Measures and Attributes](f7272c0e8be34ce782d04304580c0243.html).
590833933.title: New Image URL Semantic Type

590833934.text: In the data layer, you can now see that, in many cases, the names of data objects is turned into a link. Clicking one of these names allows you to open the object in its editor in a new tab and edit it without interrupting your work.
590833934.title: Easy Navigation from Objects to Editors in the Data Layer

590833935.text:
You can now deploy multiple task chains at the same time, in addition to other objects, with the deploy option in the Data Builder or Repository Explorer.
See:
- [Repository Explorer](f8ce0b4a24fe473a962176c8aa3cad42.html)
- [Modeling Data](5c1e3d4a49554fcd8fcf199d664d1109.html)
590833935.title: Mass Deployment of Task Chains in the Data Builder and the Repository Explorer

590833936.text:
In a Data Flow, the Script node now allows you to identify columns added in the node at a glance with the  (New Column) icon.
See [Create a Script in a Data Flow](f3e2570966ac4036b552ebd998274af1.html).
590833936.title: Identifying New Columns in a Data Flow Script Node

590833937.text:
When creating or editing a task chain, you can now set up email notification for deployed task chains to notify selected users of task chain run completion. You can pick users to be notified from a list of tenant member users or specify the email addresses of any user within the same domain as the tenant owner.
See [Creating a Task Chain](d1afbc2b9ee84d44a00b0b777ac243e1.html).
590833937.title: Email Notification of Task Chain Runs

590833938.text:
Diagrams can contain a large number or objects, and searching for them is made easy thanks to the new search bar present in the dialog toolbar.
See [Impact and Lineage Analysis](9da4892cb0e4427ab80ad8d89e6676b8.html).
590833938.title: Searching for Objects in the Impact and Lineage Analysis Diagram

590833939.text:
You can now edit custom CSN Annotations in the Table Editor, Graphical View Editor, SQL View Editor, and E/R Model Editor.
See [Edit Custom CSN Annotations in a View or Table](820d01351cd444be893af8326c1d2a9c.html).
590833939.title: Editing Custom CSN Annotations in All Data Layer Editors

590833940.text:
You can now enable time-dependency in your dimension or text entity to define periods of validity for each row and ensure that only the appropriate dimension members with the correct names are displayed for any given time period.
See [Enable Time-Dependency for a Dimension or Text Entity](11b2ff4179a14c379bfdf7b7b85b09a1.html).
590833940.title: Enable Time-Dependency for a Dimension or Text Entity

590833941.text: You are now able to use the Data Flow Monitor while the data flow runtime service is down and to see information from the latest runtime service availability. Refresh the page to see the latest data.
590833941.title: Monitoring a Data Flow while the Runtime Service is Unavailable

590833942.text:
The Impact and Lineage Analysis dialog has been improved:
- Get a better understanding of the impact and lineage of the metadata dependencies going through the diagram with the new Dependency Analysis diagram.
- Display a new analysis around any object present on the diagram.
- Navigate the diagram with ease by choosing to only display information relevant to you. Display only the lineage, the impact, or both. You can also display the full branch of any object.
See [Impact and Lineage Analysis](9da4892cb0e4427ab80ad8d89e6676b8.html).
590833942.title: Improvements for the Impact and Lineage Analysis Dialog

590833943.text:
A number of enhancements are available in the data preview:
- There is no limit to a maximum of 1,000 lines anymore. Instead, the preview header indicates the total number of rows that can be displayed by scrolling down.
- You can now show, hide, sort, and filter on multiple columns by clicking  (Columns Settings).
- Handling of input parameters has improved in the Graphical View editor, Table Editor, and SQL View editor. You can click the input parameter strip to change the input parameter values.
- To avoid long loading times, you will now receive a warning message for non-replicating remote tables.
See [Viewing Object Data](b338e4aa7e7e494eb68c383720ebfd3a.html).
590833943.title: Revised Data Preview in Graphical and SQL View Editor

590833944.text:
Deploy large quantities of tables, graphical views, SQL views, Data Access Controls, and Analytic Models with the deploy option in the Data Builder and Repository Explorer.
See [Repository Explorer](f8ce0b4a24fe473a962176c8aa3cad42.html) and [Modeling Data](5c1e3d4a49554fcd8fcf199d664d1109.html).
590833944.title: Mass Deployment of Objects in the Data Builder and the Repository Explorer

590833945.text:
To add large Odata source files in a Data Flow, enable the Batch Query option in the Advanced properties section of an odata node. It will fetch the data batch by batch according to the fetch size defined.
See [Add a Source to a Data Flow](7b50e8e304244ced9ff1e62e2f2fe919.html).
590833945.title: Enable Batch Query in Data Flow to Fetch Large Odata Source Files

590833946.text:
In the Graphical View editor, you can now add any node after an Aggregation node.
See [Aggregate Data in a Graphical View](7733250f9d2a46b690a5288634d269f0.html).
590833946.title: Modeling After an Aggregation

590833947.text:
You can now access the Impact and Lineage diagram from any editor in the Data Builder. This allows you to get a better understanding of the impact and lineage of your data object on the spot, without having to leave the editor you are working in.
See [Creating a Local Table](2509fe4d86aa472b9858164b55b38077.html), [Creating a Graphical View](27efb479c4814252964d3fbc6ca2dfc3.html), [Creating an SQL View](81920e4d583f45fd8761c662d3c8abab.html), [Creating an Entity-Relationship Model](a91c042549fb497384e756d5f5c71fde.html).
590833947.title: Easy Access to the Impact and Lineage Analysis Diagram

590833948.text:
When using the geo-coordinates column in an SAP Analytics Cloud geo map, the Choropleth / Drill type of layer is supported.
See [Create a Geo-Coordinates Column in a Graphical View](6f3ffbd077294cfaa6ae159f45d130b7.html).
590833948.title: New Geo-Coordinates Layer: Choropleth / Drill

590833949.text: The performances of the Repository search have been enhanced for all editors. Loading repository objects is faster and limited to 500 objects.
590833949.title: Searching Objects in the Repository

590833950.text: The maximum length of technical names for Data Builder objects (graphical and SQL views, tables, E/R models) is now 50 characters.
590833950.title: Increased Length of Technical Names for Data Builder Objects

590833951.text:
You can now create and schedule task chains, which allow you to define a group or series of tasks that are executed in sequence. You can run task chains manually or define a schedule for their execution. Tasks chains may include execution of Remote Table Replication, View Persistency, and Data Flow runs.
See [Creating a Task Chain](d1afbc2b9ee84d44a00b0b777ac243e1.html).
590833951.title: Task Chain Creation and Scheduling

590833952.text: Time dimensions' day names are replaced by corresponding day numbers of the month. For example, the time dimension for Monday, the 7th of November 2022 will show "7" instead of "Monday". This increases SAP Data Warehouse Cloud's alignment with SAP Analytics Cloud. You will still be able to show day names in SAP Analytics Cloud via table's properties. Existing time dimensions won't be affected by the change and will need to be refreshed.
590833952.title: Improved SAC Time-Series Chart: Time Dimensions' Day Names Become Day Numbers

590833953.text:
Your modeling capabilities have been enhanced as you can now add any node(s) after a union node in the Graphical View editor.
See [Creating a Graphical View](27efb479c4814252964d3fbc6ca2dfc3.html).
590833953.title: Modeling after a union

590833954.text:
If a source in your data flow is a JSON or Excel file, you can now change the data type of a column and modify its corresponding properties.
See [Add a Source to a Data Flow](7b50e8e304244ced9ff1e62e2f2fe919.html).
590833954.title: Modify Column Data Type for JSON and Excel files

590833955.text:
Support for import and refresh of data structure changes has been added for remote sources connected via SAP HANA smart data access, in addition to existing support for connections via SAP HANA smart data integration.
See [Process Source Changes in the Table Editor](622328b59afa40fd810b44ac84d6afd3.html) and [Review and Edit Imported Table Properties](75cea7b1cbeb4c9dba0ac13605c527b3.html).
590833955.title: Enhanced Import of Structure Changes for Remote Data Connections

590833956.text:
You can now generate currency conversion views and the necessary supporting objects from an SAP connection or manually.
See [Enabling Currency Conversion with TCUR* Tables and Views](b462239ffb644d9baab4442a10a72edf.html).
590833956.title: Enable Currency Conversion with TCUR* Tables and Views

590833957.text:
You can now set the semantic usage of a table to Hierarchy directly. Previously, only views could be identified as external hierarchies.
See [Create an External Hierarchy for Drill-Down](dbac7a862b3744d8a71d268644aac389.html).
590833957.title: Identify Tables as Hierarchies

590833958.text:
The dwc command line interface, which could previously only be used by Administrators and Space Administrators, is now available to Modelers who want to import and export entities to and from their space.
See [Importing and Exporting Objects via the Command Line](649465700ff14cd3ab7aebd72f370115.html).
590833958.title: Use the <samp class="ph codeph">dwc</samp> Command Line Interface to Import and Export Entities

590833959.text:
You can now modify views containing input parameters including if they are used as sources by other views.
See [Modifying Objects That Have Dependent Objects](f315863264db489593c7f54f1f7fd83e.html).
590833959.title: Modify Views with Input Parameters

590833960.text:
In the graphical view editor, the new Copy From Source… option in the Associations list lets you select from among the associations that are defined on your view’s sources and recreate them in your view.
See [Create an Association to Define a Semantic Relationship Between Entities](66c6998af9974dac8f54a46515777560.html).
590833960.title: Copy Associations From View Sources

590833961.text:
You can control the data being read from a remote source by adding/deleting columns from source and by adding new/removed columns from the source based on latest metadata.
See [Add a Source to a Data Flow](7b50e8e304244ced9ff1e62e2f2fe919.html).
590833961.title: Column Selection and Metadata Refresh for Remote Sources in Data Flow

590833962.text:
You can now import existing entities from SAP S/4HANA Cloud into SAP Data Warehouse Cloud in order to build new models on top of them or enhance them.
See [Importing Entities with Semantics from SAP S/4HANA](845fedbd28574aa8b84239df848936f6.html).
590833962.title: Import SAP S/4HANA Entities

590833963.text:
The Python script operator is now offering support for data manipulation and vector operations via support for the builtins (version 3.9), NumPy (version 1.21.5), and Pandas (version 1.2.5) modules.
See [Script Operator Python Reference](73e8ba1a69cd4eeba722b458a253779d.html).
590833963.title: Python 3.9 Support for Script Operator in Data Flow

590833964.text:
You can now set a default value for each of your input parameters. When a user is required to enter a value for a parameter, they can accept the default value or override it with their own chosen value.
See [Create an Input Parameter in a Graphical View](53fa99ad58c04a1ba3bb87288756dabc.html).
590833964.title: Input Parameter Default Values

590833965.text:
New validation messages help you set appropriate key columns for your entities based on their semantic usage and to map the necessary key columns when creating associations.
See [Set Key Columns to Uniquely Identify Records](d9ef2c91f6d647e584bad51999e441cd.html) and [Create an Association to Define a Semantic Relationship Between Entities](66c6998af9974dac8f54a46515777560.html).
590833965.title: New Guidance for Keys and Associations

590833966.text:
You can now create local copies of objects with the Save As function.
See the various Business Layer's and the Data Layer's editors' pages.
590833966.title: Make a Local Copy of Your Object with the Save As Function

590833967.text:
Up to now, the import of remote tables has only been available indirectly through the Data Builder when creating a view or a E/R model. Now you can import remote tables into your space directly from the Data Builder start page or the Repository Explorer.
See [Import Remote Tables](fd04efbac29c44fb8cfeaf2166b3d882.html).
590833967.title: Import Remote Tables

590833968.text:
You can now manually allocate the memory usage for your data flow if your data flow run is facing out-of-memory failures.
See [Creating a Data Flow](e30fd1417e954577baae3246ea470c3f.html).
590833968.title: Dynamic Memory Allocation for Data Flows

590833969.text:
You can now enable automatic restart of data flows in case of any failures or system upgrade.
See [Creating a Data Flow](e30fd1417e954577baae3246ea470c3f.html).
590833969.title: Automatic Restart of Data Flows

590833970.text:
Calculate values in different currencies with a Currency Conversion column. You can create a Currency Conversion column via the Calculated Column node in a graphical view.
See [Create a Currency Conversion Column in a Graphical View](6e3d8bed7ece4c27ba10e2cc523915fe.html).
590833970.title: Convert Currencies in a Graphical View

590833971.text:
You can now schedule a data flow from the data flow builder. You can also modify the existing schedule of a data flow or delete it.
See [Creating a Data Flow](e30fd1417e954577baae3246ea470c3f.html).
590833971.title: Schedule Data Flow in Data Flow Builder

590833972.text:
You can now import Excel files (.xlsx, .xls) from a remote file storage to your data flow and configure the worksheet to be used.
See [Creating a Data Flow](e30fd1417e954577baae3246ea470c3f.html).
590833972.title: Excel File as a Source in Data Flow

590833973.text:
From the Data Builder, you can now act on your remote table data and view persistency directly without switching back to the Data Integration Monitor:
- Remote Table:
Load new snapshot of data, remove replicated data and enable real-time access directly from the table editor. You can also define a schedule to automate these actions.
See [Importing Tables and Views from Sources](7c4acd33e39a451e99c87f0661772443.html).
- View Persistency:
Automate the view persistency actions defining a schedule.
See [Persist Data in a Graphical or SQL View](9bd12cf116ae40e09cdba8b60cf75e11.html).
590833973.title: Remote Table Data and View Persistency

590833974.text:
The structure of tables that you import from an Open SQL schema or an HDI container can change over time, with columns added or being removed, for example. You can now click Refresh in the table editor to check for and import these structural changes, with validation messages being displayed if the changes risk impacting objects that use the table as a source.
See [Process Source Changes in the Table Editor](622328b59afa40fd810b44ac84d6afd3.html).
590833974.title: Processing Source Changes in the Table Editor

590833975.text:
You can hide or show measures and attributes in Stories in a graphical view.
See [Specify Measures to Analyze](33f7f291538a44a293a89f6f1cf1fa81.html) and [Specify Attributes as Keys, Units, and Other Characteristics](cedc59c994cf488bb6b43b105e72c4d3.html).
590833975.title: Controlling the Visibility of Measures and Attributes in Stories

590833976.text:
The number of input parameters in a view is now displayed on its symbol (as a source or output) in the graphical view editor. In addition, when you select an input parameter in the output node side panel, each node in which it is used and, if appropriate, its source is highlighted.
See [Create an Input Parameter in a Graphical View](53fa99ad58c04a1ba3bb87288756dabc.html) and [Visualize Column and Input Parameter Lineages in a Graphical View](a2426b7597c64d5fbfcaeb67415787bd.html).
590833976.title: Improved Visibility for Input Parameters in Graphical Views

590833977.text: You can now use values in custom application attributes provided by your identity provider as identifiers in your data access controls and define conditions that apply to users with these values. Using attributes in this way allows you to apply a single condition to all users whose accounts contain the specified attribute value. See [Use Identity Provider Attributes as Identifiers in Data Access Controls](40f493f922f24663aa8191ad1e79cb77.html).
590833977.title: Define Row-Level Authorizations Based on IdP User Attributes

590833978.text:
If your "Single Values" or "Hierarchy" data access control was created before this version then you should redeploy it and any objects that consume it to obtain performance improvements.Note
"Operator and Values" and "Hierarchy with Directory" data access controls are not affected by this change and do not require any action.
See:[Securing Data with Data Access Controls](a032e51c730147c7a1fcac125b4cfe14.html)
590833978.title: Performance Improvements for "Single Values" and "Hierarchy" Data Access Controls

590833979.text: You can now create data access controls in which criteria are defined as hierarchy values in a hierarchy with directory. Each user can only see the records that match the hierarchy values she is authorized for in the permissions entity, along with any of their descendants. See [Create a "Hierarchy with Directory" Data Access Control](44ae6289f96949f48781959f9d284578.html).
590833979.title: "Hierarchy with Directory" Data Access Controls

590833980.text: The Deployment Status and Deployed On fields are now available in the data access control editor.See [Securing Data with Data Access Controls](a032e51c730147c7a1fcac125b4cfe14.html).
590833980.title: Data Access Control Deployment Status and Date

590833981.text: Certain SAP Datasphere security settings are now integrated into SAP Cloud ALM.See [SAP Datasphere Security Recommendations](4b14c62a62eb4c83bb74e33f5a646aa5.html), [Configuration & Security Analysis](https://help.sap.com/docs/cloud-alm/applicationhelp/configuration-security-analysis) in the SAP Cloud ALM - Application Help, and [Configuration & Security Analysis – Content](https://support.sap.com/en/alm/sap-cloud-alm/operations/expert-portal/configuration-security-analysis/csa-content.html/) on the SAP Cloud ALM for Operations Expert Portal.
590833981.title: SAP Datasphere Integrated into SAP Cloud ALM for Security Settings

590833982.text:
You can now open your permissions entity directly from the data access control editor, allowing you to quickly review permissions data.See:
- [Create a "Single Values" Data Access Control](5246328ec59045cb9c2aa693daee2557.html)
- [Create an "Operator and Values" Data Access Control](501594bf2afb4e49ab5ce254e35e3504.html)
- [Create a "Hierarchy" Data Access Control](0afeeed6b56a40f5a02581032ec39420.html)
590833982.title: Open Permissions Entity from Data Access Control Editor

590833983.text: You can now use the View as User tool in the Data Viewer panel to review the effects of the data access controls you apply by checking the records that another user will be allowed to see.See [Viewing Object Data](b338e4aa7e7e494eb68c383720ebfd3a.html).
590833983.title: View Data as Another User

590833984.text:
Data access controls are now listed in the Data Builder app.Note
In addtion to the Data Warehouse Data Access Control (CRUD----) privileges, users needing to create and edit data access controls must also have Data Warehouse Data Builder (CRUD----). All necessary permissions are included in the standard DW Space Administrator role.
In addition, you can now import and export data access controls in CSN/JSON files.
If you have previously bookmarked any data access controls, you should update your bookmarks from:https://<tenant_url>/index.html#/authorizations&/auth/<SpaceID>/<TechnicalName>To:https://<tenant_url>/index.html#/databuilder&/db/<SpaceID>/<TechnicalName>
See:
- [Securing Data with Data Access Controls](a032e51c730147c7a1fcac125b4cfe14.html)
- [Importing and Exporting Objects in CSN/JSON Files](f8ff0628c9fc49229740ffcd4d20e9aa.html)
- [Privileges by App, Tool, Object, and Task](2d8b7d04dcae402f911d119437ce0a74.html)
.
590833984.title: Data Access Controls Move to Data Builder App

590833985.text: You can now create data access controls in which criteria are defined as hierarchy values. Each user can only see the records that match the hierarchy values she is authorized for in the permissions entity, along with any of their descendants. See [Create a "Hierarchy" Data Access Control](0afeeed6b56a40f5a02581032ec39420.html).
590833985.title: Hierarchy Data Access Controls

590833986.text: You can now create data access controls in which criteria are defined as operator and value pairs.
